items.label: HS&E test for operatives
items.value: 50 questions in 45 minutes · pass mark 90% (45 out of 50)

sources.ref: About the Operatives HS&E test; Structure of the tests

items.label: Booking the test
items.value: £23.50 · free reschedule online up to 72 hours before · full refund if you cancel online at least 72 hours before

sources.ref: Cost of the test; Cancelling or rescheduling a test

review.checkedAgainst: CITB About the HS&E test page, 14 Oct 2026

items.label: RIDDOR reporting
items.value: Death, specified injury, dangerous occurrence: notify without delay, report within 10 days · over-7-day injury: within 15 days · over-3-day: record only

sources.ref: When do I need to report?

review.checkedAgainst: RIDDOR 2013 regs 4(2), 12(1)(c), Sch 1 para 1; HSE RIDDOR pages

items.label: Notifying HSE of a project (CDM)
items.value: Over 30 working days with more than 20 workers at once, or over 500 person days

items.label: Written safety policy and risk assessment
items.value: Required when there are 5 or more employees

sources.doc: Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974
Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations 1999

review.checkedAgainst: HSWA s2(3) with SI 1975/1584 reg 2; MHSWR reg 3(6)

items.label: First aid on higher-hazard work (suggested)
items.value: Under 5 workers: an appointed person · 5–50: at least 1 first-aider (EFAW or FAW) · over 50: 1 FAW first-aider per 50

sources.doc: HSE INDG214 First aid at work

items.label: Fire watch after hot work
items.value: Continuous for at least 1 hour after the work ends, then a further check 2 hours after

sources.doc: HSE HSG168 Fire safety in construction

items.label: Waste paperwork
items.value: Waste transfer notes kept 2 years · hazardous waste consignment notes kept 3 years

sources.doc: Waste duty of care: code of practice

review.checkedAgainst: Waste duty of care code of practice, section 3.6

items.label: Safety sign colours
items.value: Prohibition: red, at least 35% of the sign · warning (yellow), mandatory (blue), safe condition (green), fire (red): at least 50%

sources.doc: HSE L64 Safety signs and signals

review.checkedAgainst: Safety Signs and Signals Regs 1996 Schedule 1 (HSE L64)

items.label: Guard rails (work at height)
items.value: Top rail at least 950 mm high · gap between rails no more than 470 mm

items.label: Scaffold / working platform inspection
items.value: Where you could fall 2 m or more: inspected within the previous 7 days, and after anything that could affect its safety

items.label: Excavation inspection
items.value: At the start of each shift, after any event that may affect its strength or stability, and after any fall of material

items.label: Thorough examination of lifting equipment
items.value: Equipment for lifting people (e.g. MEWPs) and lifting accessories: every 6 months · other lifting equipment: every 12 months (or by an examination scheme)

items.label: Ladders (HSE guidance)
items.value: Angle 1 in 4 (75°) · don't work off the top three rungs · over 30 minutes at a time: use other equipment

sources.doc: HSE: Safe use of ladders and stepladders
